defs.def: to send sth somewhere in large numbers 大量送至；挤满；拥满
to become or make sth become available in a place in large numbers （使）充斥，充满
to affect sb suddenly and strongly 使大受感动；充满
to spread suddenly into sth; to cover sth 照进；覆盖
